title: Normalized derived tensors on the component square
statement: For a commutative condensed ring Λ and any OrdinarySystem s Λ [def-zl-component-derived-square-data], there is a TensorSystem Λ s: every ordinary component, slice and scheme module inverse image has its normalized strong symmetric derived tensor structure, the localization factorization is monoidal and the derived square Square.theta respects tensor and coefficient unit. This asserts no derived identity/composition equation and no dualizability statement.

proof.text: Equip the four site morphisms of the supplied OrdinarySystem with their structural coefficient maps. The coefficient equation of each Square (Square.coefficient, with Corner.coefficient_eq and Slice.coefficient_eq) is the ring-map compatibility required for the specified geometric 2-isomorphism Square.abelian. The ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons theorem now makes their derived pullbacks symmetric strong monoidal and makes the induced 2-isomorphism monoidal, including its unit. Exactness identifies these pullbacks with the termwise derived functors by the exact-derived-functor theorem; the representative formulas identify its 2-isomorphism with the localized termwise comparison Square.theta of Square.ordinary. Consequently, writing $A=f^*\pi_X^*$, $B=\pi_Y^*h^*$ and $t_A,t_B$ for their tensor comparisons, $t_B\theta_{K\otimes^L L}=(\theta_K\otimes^L\theta_L)t_A$. At the unit the equation is $e_B\theta_{\Lambda_P}=e_A$, where $e_A,e_B$ are the canonical coefficient identifications Corner.coefficient and Slice.coefficient. These are ordinary derived tensors, with no completion.
